notes.summary: activityLog.hiddenTools lists tools (model-facing names) that never appear in the activity log, e.g. UI-only refresh or toast actions; they still run.
notes.howTo: activityLog={{ hiddenTools: ['ui_action_toast', 'ui_action_refresh'] }} (config.activityLog on <glirastes-chat>). Hidden tools are no step, no summary count, no section split and do not hide the typing indicator. A hand-built ChatContextValue (a test mock of useChatContext) sets activityLog.hiddenTools: [].

notes.summary: AssistantShell renders full screen as a modal and offers it when its modes list includes 'fullscreen'; useAssistantLayout().setMode('fullscreen') opens it, restoreMode() leaves it.
notes.howTo: Add 'fullscreen' to AssistantShell/AssistantWorkspace modes; setMode('fullscreen') opens full screen, restoreMode() or Escape returns to defaultMode. A UI action that shows page UI calls restoreMode() first or puts that UI above --cm-chat-fullscreen-z (default 1000); page portals that must stay usable carry data-cm-keep-interactive.

notes.summary: In full screen AssistantShell shows the chat list as a left column (a drawer below 900 px) when the chat keeps several; historyPane={false} removes it, a node replaces it.
notes.howTo: Nothing to do for the default: with modes including 'fullscreen' and a chat that keeps several conversations, full screen shows SessionSwitcher variant="list" in a 260 px column and names the open chat in the header. historyPane={false} keeps the header switcher instead; historyPane={<MyPane />} renders an own column. Labels history, showHistory, hideHistory (German ships); icon history.

notes.summary: AssistantShell and AssistantWorkspace take modes. With 'fullscreen' in it the header shows a layout menu (sidebar, window, full screen) instead of the detach/dock button; a single mode hides the layout control.
notes.howTo: Pass modes={['sidebar', 'floating', 'fullscreen']} to AssistantWorkspace or AssistantShell. A layout outside modes falls back (full screen to defaultMode, otherwise the first entry); one entry removes the layout control and the layout shortcut. A renderButton receives expanded and controls for the new 'mode' and 'history' buttons (map to aria-expanded / aria-controls, and aria-haspopup="menu" for 'mode'). New optional labels layout, sidebar, floating and icons fullscreen, history.

notes.summary: Type-only: AssistantLayoutMode gains 'fullscreen', AssistantShellAction gains 'mode' and 'history', AssistantLayout gains required restoreMode. Exhaustive switches, Records keyed by these unions and hand-built AssistantLayout mocks stop compiling. Runtime is unchanged without modes.
notes.howTo: Add 'fullscreen' cases (AssistantLayoutMode), 'mode' and 'history' cases (AssistantShellAction, e.g. in renderButton) and restoreMode to hand-built AssistantLayout values.

notes.summary: AssistantShell and AssistantWorkspace take minPageWidth: the docked assistant never grows so wide that the page gets less than that. The width handle now announces and stops at the widest width that can render.
notes.howTo: Pass minPageWidth={480} (omnify uses 520) to keep the page usable on laptops; the user's chosen width comes back on wider windows.

notes.summary: onCompletionSelect returning true now also removes the typed trigger and query when the handler put text or a pill before them; when the text became ambiguous nothing is removed.
notes.howTo: Nothing to change. A handler that worked around the leftover trigger (for example by deleting '#query' itself after setText or insertMention before it) can drop that workaround. After a rebuild the SDK removes the trigger text only when it occurs exactly once as a whole word (so '#bug-7' put in for '#bu' is never cut); when it occurs more than once it removes nothing, so the handler keeps control of the text.

notes.summary: composer.clarificationChips shows the options of an open clarification as chips above the composer; the card in the message then keeps question and free text only (ClarificationCardProps.showOptions). ClarificationChips renders them in own panels.
notes.howTo: Set composer: { clarificationChips: true } on AiChatProvider. A chip sends the same answer as the card's option button; chips hide while a turn runs, once answered and for free-text-only clarifications, and are disabled while the composer is locked. A custom components.ClarificationCard receives showOptions (false while chips are on) and should leave its option buttons out then. Own panels render <ClarificationChips /> above the composer; group name locale.clarificationChipsLabel. See references/composer-starters-drafts.md#clarification-chips.

notes.summary: Visible change: composer text now belongs to its chat. Switching chats shows that chat's unsent text instead of carrying the text over, and the text survives a remount of the input.
notes.howTo: Nothing to configure. Tests or flows that expect the composer text to move into another chat after a session switch must switch back (or set the text again with useChatComposer().setDraft). Pills are kept with their ids; attachments are not part of a draft. Drafts live as long as the AiChatProvider instance: remount the provider with a key per verified identity so another user never sees them. Own session stores can use the ComposerDraft shape ({ text, mentions? }). See references/composer-starters-drafts.md#drafts.

notes.summary: composer.hint shows a keyboard hint line under the composer (send, new line; the list keys while a completion list is open). ComposerHint renders it in own composers; RichMentionInput reports its list with onListOpenChange.
notes.howTo: Set composer: { hint: true } on AiChatProvider. Texts come from the locale keys composerHintSend, composerHintNewline, composerHintNavigate, composerHintPick and composerHintClose (German in deChatLocale). An own composer on useChatComposerInput renders <ComposerHint completionOpen={composer.completionOpen} />; composer.inputProps already passes onListOpenChange to RichMentionInput. The hint is aria-hidden and hidden on touch devices. See references/composer-starters-drafts.md#hint-line.

notes.summary: Composer "+" menu rows show an icon and a description (composer.items description, trigger icon and description); composer.renderIcon turns string icon names of completion entries into elements. Visible: plusMenu.source rows now show the entry's description.
notes.howTo: Add description to a composer.items entry or icon/description to a ChatTriggerDefinition to show them in the "+" menu; a trigger:<char> toolbar button then shows the icon instead of the char. Pass composer.renderIcon: (name, { type, trigger }) => element to render string icons of completion entries (CompletionItem.icon, ChatCommandDefinition.icon, ChatEntityDefinition.icon) in the default list item and in plusMenu.source rows; without it string icons render nothing, as before. Apps using plusMenu.source: rows of entries that have a description now show it under the label (styled with --cm-text-muted); drop the description from those entries if the menu should stay single-line. See references/composer-triggers-toolbar.md#row-descriptions-and-icons.

notes.summary: composer.layout: 'stacked' puts the editor on its own row and the toolbar items in a row under it; the default 'inline' keeps today's single row.
notes.howTo: Set composer: { layout: 'stacked', toolbar: { start: ['plus', 'trigger:@', 'trigger:/'], end: ['mic', 'send'] } } on AiChatProvider. The row is div[data-component="composer-toolbar"][data-layout="stacked"] with toolbar-start and toolbar-end. components.ComposerToolbar still replaces both layouts. See references/composer-triggers-toolbar.md#layout.

notes.summary: composer.starters shows starter chips above the composer on an empty chat; a click fills the composer (send: true sends). ChatStarters renders them in own panels; while they show, suggestions.staticChips are hidden.
notes.howTo: Set composer: { starters: ['Was ist neu?', { label, prompt, description, icon, send }] } on AiChatProvider. A click puts prompt (default label) into the composer and focuses it; send: true sends at once. Chips are disabled while the composer is locked and disappear with the first message. String icons render through composer.renderIcon(name, { type: 'starter' }). If you used suggestions.staticChips as starters, move them to composer.starters: the static chips are hidden on an empty chat while starters show. Own panels render <ChatStarters /> above the composer. Group name: locale.startersLabel. See references/composer-starters-drafts.md#starters.

notes.summary: suggestions.placement: 'message' shows the model's follow-up questions as buttons under the latest answer (heading 'Ask next') instead of the rotating chip above the composer; hidden while a turn runs, an approval or clarification is open, or after a stop or error.
notes.howTo: suggestions={{ placement: 'message', count: 3 }}. The SuggestionBar and staticChips are not shown then; use composer.starters for an empty chat. Server follow-ups require pipeline: createAiChatHandler registers suggest_followups only with followups and pipeline and warns once at creation when followups is set without pipeline; without them the UI reads a trailing suggestion list of the answer. Heading text: followUpsLabel.

notes.summary: messageFooter adds a footer under each answer: copy as formatted and plain text, the https sources it cites, 'Done in 3.2 s', and the elapsed time with a stop button while it runs. Off by default; useMessageParts and MessageParts get it as footer.
notes.howTo: <VercelAiChat messageFooter /> or messageFooter={{ stop: false }}. A custom MessageParts that does not render children places parts.footer itself. Texts: copyMessageLabel, copiedMessageLabel, copyMessageFailedLabel, messageSourceOneLabel, messageSourcesLabel, messageDurationLabel (German in deChatLocale). Nothing is sent anywhere.

notes.summary: useChatComposer (insertText, setDraft, chatAbout, clear, focus) now also fills the plain chat input; mentions arrive there as text.
notes.howTo: Nothing to change. Without chatInteractions or completionProviders the chat input is a plain textarea; useChatComposer operations used to be ignored there and now apply: insertText appends, setDraft replaces, clear empties, focus focuses, and insertMention/chatAbout put the mention's visible text (for example @Bug 7 or /Open tasks) at the caret. openCompletion still does nothing in the plain input, which has no list.

notes.summary: createLocalSessionStore now keeps each chat's unsent composer text in the same browser storage and key prefix as the chat, so it survives a reload; drafts: false turns it off. Own SessionConfig stores can add draft.
notes.howTo: Nothing to do with createLocalSessionStore: drafts are stored as `${storageKey}:draft:<chatId>` and removed when sent, when the chat is removed, cleared or evicted, and by clearLocalSessionStore on sign-out (stores created before it write no drafts any more, so create a new store for the next sign-in). Pass drafts: false to keep them in memory only. An own SessionConfig can add draft: { load(id), save(id, draft | null) } (ComposerDraftStorage); writes are debounced 300 ms and flushed on chat switch and pagehide, drafts over 20,000 characters are not written, errors are ignored. See references/composer-starters-drafts.md#drafts-across-reloads.

notes.summary: SessionSwitcher takes variant="list" for an always visible chat list (new chat, recent chats, rename, delete, arrow keys) and onSelect, called after a pick or a new chat.
notes.howTo: Render <SessionSwitcher variant="list" onSelect={() => …} /> in an own side column; it needs a chat that keeps several conversations (renders nothing otherwise). Texts: locale.chatHistoryLabel (navigation name) and locale.recentChatsLabel (heading); German ships. onSelect also works on the default dropdown.

notes.summary: Visible fix: the SuggestionBar now shows nothing with suggestions.enabled: false (it used to show follow-up and static chips anyway), and a turn that brings no follow-ups no longer keeps showing the previous turn's chips; the static chips (or none) show instead.
notes.howTo: Nothing to change if the bar should behave as configured. An app that set suggestions.enabled: false but relied on the chips showing anyway removes enabled: false. An app that relied on a turn's follow-ups staying visible after later turns keeps them itself (useSuggestions().chips, onTurnEnd) or sets staticChips as the fallback.

notes.summary: A recorded TurnOutcome now carries durationMs, the time the turn's requests ran (approval waits excluded), measured in the browser and stored with the outcome in the session store.
notes.howTo: Read outcome.durationMs in onTurnEnd or useTurnOutcome for your own timing display or local analytics; messageFooter shows it as 'Done in 3.2 s'. Tests that compare whole outcomes with toEqual need the new member.
